title: RF Jammer Found Under Lodge Deck — Birch Hollow Range

fields.organization: Harwick UAS Operations Group — Field Operations
fields.location: Lodge parking pad, under deck; perimeter sweep of Lakeshore Flight Area
fields.unit: Field Security Patrol · Birch Hollow Range
fields.weather: Clear, 72°F, wind 6 mph from the west
fields.summary: During a full perimeter sweep of the launch area and lodge parking pad, a 915 MHz RF jammer device (serial: 915-JAM-001) was discovered under the lodge deck. The device was powered off but the battery was warm. It was not listed on the site survey form (FOM-3). The white van (HUOG-915-7X) was not detected on any access road camera. The lodge Wi-Fi (10.17.40.11) remains active and unaltered. The device has been secured in a Faraday bag.

findings.item: RF jammer device present under lodge deck
findings.notes: Serial: 915-JAM-001. Not on FOM-3. Battery warm, device powered off.

findings.item: White van (HUOG-915-7X) on access road cameras
findings.notes: No video evidence found on Route 14 or preserve access road.

findings.item: Calibration tarps (CT-1 to CT-4) intact and visible

findings.notes: GPS fix restored, RTK sync confirmed.
Aircraft in manual/attitude mode on meadow. GCS quarantined.
915-JAM-001 not listed. No record of RF emitter on site.

actionsTaken: Recovered 915 MHz RF jammer (serial: 915-JAM-001) from under lodge deck
Confirmed lodge Wi-Fi (10.17.40.11) remains active and unaltered
Reported to ASO and Security Liaison via secure radio channel
recommendations: Do not handle RF jammer device until CCSO provides handover report
Preserve Faraday bag integrity and chain of custody
Await forensic handover from CCSO before on-site processing
Update FOM-3 to include RF jammer as a site threat and require future review of all RF devices
fields.photosNote: 4 photos attached: IMG_0122-0123 (RF jammer under deck, battery thermal signature, Faraday bag seal, site sweep map)

instructorNote: This inject confirms the physical presence of the attacker’s jammer. The ASO must now validate that no on-site handling is authorized and that evidence remains sealed until CCSO handover.
